_doc: Shared canonical V3 pool for the ADR-005 Tier-2 pool-builder dual-driver parity tests (task A2QRWO). Loaded by BOTH rust/crates/degenbot/tests/parity_pool_builder.rs (Rust consumer, BotState directly) AND tests/standalone_parity/test_pool_builder_dual_driver.py (Python consumer, PyBot). A 1:1-price V3 pool (sqrt_price_x96 = 2^96, tick 0), liquidity 1e12, fee 3000 (0.3%), tick_spacing 60, tick 0 seeded + Tracked coverage. This is the deterministic identity+state TUPLE a PoolBuilder.build_v3 emits after its on-chain/DB I/O — the parity asserts BOTH consumers register the SAME canonical fixture and report IDENTICAL pool id + identity (token0/token1/fee/tick_spacing) + state (sqrt_price_x96/liquidity/tick) + coverage. A deliberately-wrong edit to THIS file fails BOTH sides mechanically (the shared-fixture contract).

expected._pool_id_note: First pool registered in a fresh BotState/PyBot gets deterministic id 1 — both consumers MUST agree, proving the registration identity is identical across the FFI seam.
